2760.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — New ChocoPoC RAT Targets Vulnerability Researchers via Fake PoC Exploit Repos
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("exploit_poc.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("exploit_poc.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2760.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — New ChocoPoC RAT Targets Vulnerability Researchers via Fake PoC Exploit Repos ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("exploit_poc.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("exploit_poc.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2763.def:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let GitClones = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("git.exe","git") and ProcessCommandLine has "clone"
    | project GitTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, CloneCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ ("python.exe","python3","python","powershell.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("EXPLOIT_POC","exploit.py","poc.py")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", "/tmp/", "/Downloads/")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner GitClones on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (GitTime .. GitTime + WindowSec*1s)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, CloneCmd, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, GitTime)
| order by Timestamp desc
2763.sent:
let Window = 120s;
let GitClones = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where ActingProcessName has "git" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "clone"
    | project GitTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, CloneCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("python","powershell")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("EXPLOIT_POC","exploit.py","poc.py")
| join kind=inner GitClones on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (GitTime .. GitTime + Window)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, CloneCmd, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, GitTime)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2763.datadog: (source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.command_line:(*EXPLOIT_POC* OR *exploit.py* OR *poc.py*) @process.command_line:(*python* OR */tmp/* OR *Downloads*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\powershell.exe) @CommandLine:(*EXPLOIT_POC* OR *exploit.py* OR *poc.py*))

description: Detects a shell spawned by cron that removes a file under /etc/cron.d (run-once self-cleaning cron) or drops the CVE-2026-48753 PoC marker, indicating execution of a traversal-written malicious cron job.
references:
  - https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-ccjc-4qc3-jxqc
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/07
tags:
  - attack.t1053.003
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_selfdelete:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/cron'
      - '/crond'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'rm '
      - '/etc/cron.d/'
  selection_marker:
    CommandLine|contains: 'incus-s3-uploadid'
  condition: selection_selfdelete or selection_marker
level: high
2905.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("cron","crond") ((Processes.process="*rm *" AND Processes.process="*/etc/cron.d/*") OR Processes.process="*incus-s3-uploadid*") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| sort - lastTime
2905.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^cron[d]?$/i
| (regex("/etc/cron\\.d/", field=CommandLine) AND regex("\\brm\\b", field=CommandLine)) OR regex("incus-s3-uploadid", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
